locations.name: Incheon International Airport
locations.description: Arrival point - Buy T-money cards and KT SIM here

locations.name: Seoul Station
locations.description: KTX departure to Busan (~2.5h). Also AREX from Incheon Airport.

locations.name: Suseo Station (SRT)
locations.description: SRT high-speed rail to Busan (~2.5h). Alternative to Seoul Station KTX.

locations.name: Gwangmyeong Station
locations.description: KTX station closer to Incheon than Seoul Station. Alternative departure point for Busan.

locations.name: Busan Station
locations.description: KTX/SRT arrival from Seoul. Near Jagalchi Market and Nampo-dong.

locations.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
locations.description: Main Joseon palace, FREE last Wednesday or with hanbok, cherry blossoms April 7-14

locations.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
locations.description: Traditional Korean homes, FREE, 15-20 min walk from Gyeongbokgung

locations.name: Yeouido Park
locations.description: ⭐ CHERRY BLOSSOMS - 1,800+ trees, peak early-mid April

locations.name: Namsan Park & N Seoul Tower
locations.description: Cherry blossoms April 8-15, city views, hiking trails

locations.name: Gwangjang Market
locations.description: ⭐ Seoul's oldest market (1905), bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, most authentic

locations.name: Namdaemun Market
locations.description: 15th century, Korea's largest traditional market, Kalguksu Alley

locations.name: Myeongdong Night Market
locations.description: 100-150 stalls, lively street food, great for kids

locations.name: Lotte World
locations.description: World's largest indoor theme park, $43 adults/$33 kids, 10am-9pm, Jamsil Station

locations.name: National Museum of Korea
locations.description: FREE admission, kid-friendly

locations.name: Cheonggyecheon Stream
locations.description: Urban stream walk, family-friendly

locations.name: Gyeongju Bomun Lake
locations.description: ⭐ Historic city, cherry blossoms, romantic lakeside, 1h from Busan

locations.name: Seokguram Grotto
locations.description: UNESCO site, near Gyeongju

locations.name: Haeundae Beach
locations.description: ⭐ Iconic beach, family facilities, beach walks (no swimming in April - 12-17°C water)

locations.name: Busan Citizens Park
locations.description: ⭐ BEST stroller park - flat wide paths, playgrounds, children's library

locations.name: UN Memorial Cemetery
locations.description: Excellent for strollers - 100% flat, peaceful, free admission, near Daeyeon Station

locations.name: APEC Naru Park
locations.description: Riverside stroller paths, playground, expansive lawns, near Dongbaek Station

locations.name: Dongbaekseom Island
locations.description: Coastal walk - first 450m flat and stroller-friendly, then stairs. Near APEC House.

locations.name: Marine City
locations.description: Quiet residential high-rises, best area for baby. 10 min walk to Haeundae Beach.

locations.name: Centum City
locations.description: Near Citizens Park, Shinsegae mall, good family base. More urban, less beach vibe.

locations.name: Gwangalli Beach
locations.description: Gwangan Bridge views, 5km walk from Haeundae

locations.name: Millak Waterside Park
locations.description: Between Haeundae & Gwangalli, flat paths, picnic spot, kids water area, bridge views

locations.name: Songjeong Beach
locations.description: Quieter than Haeundae, shallow water, surfers, local vibe

locations.name: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple
locations.description: ⭐ Stunning seaside temple on cliffs, many stairs (use baby carrier), free entry

locations.name: Korea National Maritime Museum
locations.description: 4 floors, rooftop playground, free admission, good rainy day option

locations.name: Igidae Coastal Walk
locations.description: 5km dramatic cliff trail, proper hike, not for strollers

locations.name: Busan Museum of Art
locations.description: Near Centum City, calm, stroller-friendly grounds

locations.name: SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium
locations.description: ⭐ Next to Haeundae Beach, 10,000+ creatures, 80m submarine tunnel, interactive

locations.name: Gamcheon Culture Village
locations.description: ⭐ Korean Santorini, colorful hillside houses, art installations, stairs/hills

locations.name: Beomeosa Temple
locations.description: Mountain temple, hiking trails (Geumjeongsan), spring wildflowers, great for active kids

locations.name: Jagalchi Fish Market
locations.description: Korea's largest seafood market, pick live seafood, educational for kids

locations.name: Gukje Market
locations.description: 6 zones, 12 buildings, bargains, 9am-7pm, near BIFF Square

locations.name: BIFF Square
locations.description: Movie memorabilia, ssiat hotteok (sweet pancake), street food haven

locations.name: Taejongdae Resort Park
locations.description: Stunning coastal cliffs, forest trails, picnic areas

locations.name: Dalmaji Hill
locations.description: Cherry blossoms late March-early April, coastal views

locations.name: Moontan Road
locations.description: Coastal walking path near Dalmaji Hill with sea views. Easy, scenic stroll.

locations.name: Ahopsan Forest
locations.description: Peaceful bamboo and pine forest. Famous K-drama filming location. Tranquil nature walk. Gijang area.

locations.name: Cheongsapo
locations.description: Coastal village with twin lighthouses. Accessible via Blue Line Park from Mipo. Between Haeundae and Songjeong.

locations.name: Changdeokgung Palace
locations.description: Alternative palace visit (closed Tuesday), UNESCO site, Secret Garden

locations.name: Insadong
locations.description: Cultural street with traditional crafts, antique galleries, and tea houses. 5 min walk from Anguk Station.

locations.name: Jogyesa Temple
locations.description: Main temple of Korean Zen Buddhism. Peaceful city-center temple, 10 min walk from Anguk Station.

locations.name: Jongmyo Shrine
locations.description: UNESCO World Heritage. Joseon royal ancestral shrine. Guided tours only (Korean, English audio guide). 10 min walk from Anguk.

locations.name: Changgyeonggung Palace
locations.description: Connected to Changdeokgung, quieter and less crowded. Botanical garden on grounds. 10 min walk from Anguk.

locations.name: Deoksugung Palace
locations.description: Joseon palace with Western-style buildings. Famous stone wall road (Doldam-gil). Near City Hall. 20 min walk from Anguk.

locations.name: Dongmyo Flea Market
locations.description: Vintage clothing, antiques, retro finds. Great for unique souvenirs. Dongmyo Station (Lines 1/6). 20 min from Anguk.

locations.name: Hwanghakdong Antique Market
locations.description: Korea's largest antique market. Furniture, ceramics, old records, vintage goods. Near Dongmyo. Good souvenir hunting.

locations.name: Suseong-dong Valley
locations.description: Tranquil valley next to Gyeongbokgung. Joseon-era scholars' retreat. Quiet Seochon alleys. 20 min walk from Anguk.

locations.name: Hanyangdoseong Fortress Wall Trail
locations.description: 14th-century city wall ridge walk with Seoul skyline views. Naksan section is the easiest. 20 min walk from Anguk.

locations.name: Inwangsan Trail
locations.description: Panoramic sunset hike over Seoul. Beombawi Rock viewpoint ~30-40 min from trailhead. Start ~18:15 for sunset (19:05 in April).

locations.name: Seokchon Lake
locations.description: Cherry blossoms April 8-15, lakeside walks, near Lotte World

locations.name: Geumjeongsan Cable Car
locations.description: Cable car base at Geumgang Park (near Oncheonjang Station, Line 1). Rides to midpoint of Geumjeongsan. Start point for ridge hike to fortress village or Beomeosa.

locations.name: Geumjeongsanseong Village
locations.description: Mountain village inside fortress walls. Famous for Sanseong Makgeolli (rice wine) and tofu dishes (dubu). Great lunch stop on Geumjeongsan hike.

locations.name: Geumjeongsanseong Fortress
locations.description: Korea's largest mountain fortress (17km walls). Ridge walk with panoramic views of Busan. Connect cable car → fortress → village → Beomeosa for a half-day route.

locations.name: Songdo Beach
locations.description: Marine cable car, Songdo Skywalk, beach walks

locations.name: Oryukdo Islands Cruise
locations.description: 1h scenic cruise from Mipo (Haeundae), ₩19,500/person, views of 5-6 rock islands

locations.name: Gwangalli Yacht Tour
locations.description: 30-60 min yacht tour. Day/sunset/night options. Views of Gwangan Bridge, Marine City. ~₩12,000+/person

locations.name: Haeundae Blueline Park
locations.description: Scenic coastal train, ocean & mountain views, family activity

locations.name: Gunam-ro & Haeundae Market
locations.description: Lively shopping street + traditional market near Haeundae Beach. Cafes, shops, local specialties, souvenirs.

locations.name: The Bay 101
locations.description: Waterfront dining and cafes next to Dongbaek Island. Famous night view of Marine City skyline.

locations.name: Shinsegae Spa Land
locations.description: Hot spring spa & jjimjilbang in Centum City. Saunas, themed rooms, massages. Inside Shinsegae Dept Store.

locations.name: Nampo-dong
locations.description: Walking district (5-7km loop) connecting markets and BIFF Square

locations.name: Hongdae
locations.description: Trendy neighborhood, cooking classes, art, nightlife

locations.name: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress
locations.description: ⭐ UNESCO fortress, 30-60min from Seoul, walking walls, palace, chicken street

locations.name: Incheon Chinatown
locations.description: Famous jajangmyeon, walking distance from Incheon Station, colorful streets

locations.name: Songwol-dong Fairy Tale Village
locations.description: Street art, cartoon characters, photo spots, near Chinatown

locations.name: Wolmi Island
locations.description: Theme park with 115m Ferris wheel, sea views, cafes, Line 1 to Incheon Station

locations.name: Incheon Grand Park
locations.description: Large park, bike rentals, family walks, relaxing green space

locations.name: Songdo Central Park
locations.description: Modern urban park, Han River area, appeared on Korean TV shows

locations.name: Ganghwa Island
locations.description: ⭐ Island day trip, UNESCO dolmens, Jeondeungsa Temple, 1h from Incheon

locations.name: Oido Island
locations.description: Prehistoric shell mounds, seafood restaurants, beach walks, 30-40min from Incheon

locations.name: Soraepo Fish Market
locations.description: Fresh seafood market, local atmosphere, grilled fish

locations.name: Bucheon Aiins World
locations.description: Miniature world, 109 buildings from 25 countries, great for kids, 30-45min from Incheon

locations.name: Bihaksan Barley Rice & Kalguksu
locations.description: Clean side dishes and rich doenjang jjigae. Light flavors, mostly vegan except the stew.

locations.name: Kongbatgol Soft Tofu
locations.description: Rich yet mild sundubu jjigae. Simple, satisfying Korean meal.

locations.name: Badamaru Abalone Porridge
locations.description: Flavorful abalone porridge with ocean aroma and sesame oil. Special (특) has double abalone. On Dalmaji-gil.

locations.name: Geodae Gomtang
locations.description: Rich, milky beef bone broth. Very popular — expect weekend waits.

locations.name: Daenam Saengpo Galbi
locations.description: Korean BBQ — meaty ogyeopsal (five-layer pork belly), great side dishes, stew, and naengmyeon.

locations.name: Songwon Mulhoe
locations.description: Pohang-style broth-free mulhoe with chewy raw fish. Free spicy soup side is excellent. Songjeong.

locations.name: Yeongbyeon Raw Fish
locations.description: Famous for inventing finely sliced sekkosi. Fresh, chewy raw fish. Songjeong.

locations.name: Yangsan Gukbap Haeundae
locations.description: Refreshing, clean pork soup without any odor. Unique twist on pork gukbap.

locations.name: Gukbo Seaweed Soup
locations.description: Milky, thick, rich seaweed soup — considered the best miyeokguk in Busan. Gijang area.

locations.name: Giljo Shabu-Shabu
locations.description: Fresh ingredients, clean broth. Set includes beef, vegetables, noodles, porridge. Spacious — good for families. Songjeong.

locations.name: Haeundae Milmyeon
locations.description: Busan's signature chewy noodles in rich broth. Mul (cold broth) and bibim (spicy) options. Try with handmade dumplings.

locations.name: Jjang Tteokbokki
locations.description: Busan-style tteokbokki — chewy garaetteok in dark red sweet-and-spicy sauce.

locations.name: Sobok Noodles
locations.description: Well-balanced flavors, great value for a satisfying meal.

locations.name: Kitchen Whale
locations.description: Fresh, light sandwiches — try the club sandwich. 1st floor of accommodation building.

locations.name: Burger Shop
locations.description: Soft brioche buns, juicy patties. Get the set with crispy curly fries. Near Haeundae Station.

locations.name: Shilla Stay Lunch Buffet
locations.description: Lunch buffet 12-2pm. ₩30,000 weekdays / ₩36,000 weekends. Best value buffet in Haeundae.

locations.name: Georukaeng Table
locations.description: Australian-style brunch with ocean views. Try basil cream pasta, aglio e olio, arancini, hummus. Songjeong.

locations.name: Sabbia
locations.description: Smooth, delicate pasta. Best: gnocchi with subtle truffle aroma. Also fusion pasta. Dalmaji-gil.

locations.name: Pizzeria Lardo
locations.description: Wood-fired pizza with chewy dough, American-style pasta. Gwangan Bridge views. Marine City.

locations.name: The Barn Coffee
locations.description: Variety of brewed coffees with beautiful ocean views. 5th floor on Dalmaji-gil. 11am-7pm.

locations.name: Fruitary Forest
locations.description: Café in the forest near Songjeong. Pets welcome. 11am-9pm.

locations.name: Haeundae Dachi
locations.description: Multi-course chef's-choice seafood (dachi style). Sashimi, grilled, steamed, stew, abalone porridge finish. Course A ₩55K, Course B ₩80K/person. 11:30am–11pm, break 2–4pm.

locations.name: Yeije Galbi
locations.description: Premium 한우 charcoal BBQ — kkotsal, skirt, ribeye cap, tenderloin, short rib. Blue Ribbon awarded. Expensive: ~₩54–75K per cut. B1F of 팔레드시즈 building. 12pm–10pm, break 3–5:30pm.

locations.name: Miryang Sundae Gukbap Haeundae
locations.description: Busan's signature pork soup. Clean deep broth, no artificial seasoning — customize with shrimp paste, chives, salt at the table. ~₩8,500/bowl. Open 24h.

locations.name: Haeundae Wonjo Halme Gukbap
locations.description: Legendary beef gukbap since 1962. Beef or seonji (clotted ox blood) soup. ~₩7–9K/bowl. Open 24h. Can get busy — two adjoining rooms.

locations.name: Obaltan Haeundae
locations.description: Premium grilled offal — 특양 (beef abomasum) and 대창 (large intestine). Staff-managed charcoal grill. One of Korea's top yang-gupchang chains. ~₩30–45K/person. 11:30am–10pm.

locations.name: Haeundae Somunnan Samgyetang
locations.description: Whole chicken simmered in broth with glutinous rice, ginseng, garlic, jujubes. Several variants: herbal, red ginseng, abalone. ₩17–22K. 10:30am–9pm, break 3–5pm.

locations.name: Daege Manchan
locations.description: Korea's largest snow crab restaurant (732 seats). Steamed 대게 at market rate (~₩75K/kg), crab courses ₩95–150K. 4th floor, The East In Busan. Near Lotte World Adventure Busan. 11am–9:30pm.

locations.name: Bukhansan National Park
locations.description: Korea's most visited national park. Dramatic granite peaks and ridgelines. Baekundae (836m) is the highest peak.

locations.name: Dobongsan
locations.description: Northern section of Bukhansan NP. Granite spires, exposed scrambling. Jaunbong (740m). Subway: Dobongsan stn (Lines 1/7).

locations.name: Dobongsan Trailhead (Mangwolsa)
locations.description: Start of Madang Ridge → Jaunbong circuit (4-5h). Subway: Mangwolsa stn (Line 1), 15 min walk to trailhead.

locations.name: Dobongsan Trailhead (Dobongsan Stn)
locations.description: Dobong Visitor Center area. Access to Jaunbong, Sinseondae. Subway: Dobongsan stn (Lines 1/7), 15 min walk.

locations.name: Bukhansanseong Trailhead
locations.description: NW approach to Baekundae via Joseon fortress walls (4-5h). Bus 704 from Gupabal stn (Line 3).

locations.name: Uiryeong Trail (Ui Entrance)
locations.description: East entrance of Uiryeong wildlife corridor (6.8 km, 3h). Bus from Suyu stn (Line 4).

locations.name: Uiryeong Trail (Gyohyeon Entrance)
locations.description: West entrance of Uiryeong wildlife corridor (6.8 km, 3h). Bus 704 or 34 from Gupabal stn (Line 3).

locations.name: Cheonsang Gaok
locations.description: Botanical garden rooftop bakery cafe at Seongsu Yeonbang, 3F - Instagram-worthy greenhouse setting

locations.name: Cafe Onion Seongsu
locations.description: Industrial-chic cafe in converted 1970s factory, famous for signature pastries and pandoro bread

locations.name: Daelim Changgo
locations.description: 1970s rice warehouse turned cafe & gallery, one of the first viral Seongsu cafes, rooftop terrace

locations.name: Hitcoffee Roasters
locations.description: Specialty roastery in Hongdae with shutter-wall facade that opens to the street, filter coffee focus

locations.name: Compile
locations.description: Specialty coffee shop in Hongdae/Yeonnam area

locations.name: Anthracite Coffee Seogyo
locations.description: 3-floor converted shoe factory with zen garden, specialty roastery near Mangwon Station

locations.name: TREMOR Coffee Works
locations.description: Basement specialty roastery in Hongdae, known for single-origin filter coffee and wholesale blends

locations.name: Komfortabel Coffee Namsan
locations.description: 4F rooftop cafe with panoramic Namsan views, Yongsan/Huam-dong area

locations.name: Théâtre des Lumières
locations.description: Immersive digital art exhibition in Seongsu, large-scale projections of classic masterworks

locations.name: Starfield Library
locations.description: Stunning open library with 13m bookshelves inside COEX Mall, Gangnam, free entry

locations.name: Umyeonsan Observatory
locations.description: Hilltop observation deck (Somang Tower) with panoramic Seoul views, easy hike in southern Seoul

locations.name: Ikseon-dong Hanok Village
locations.description: Trendy hanok alley with cafes, boutiques and restaurants in renovated 1920s Korean houses, near Jongno 3-ga

locations.name: MMCA Deoksugung
locations.description: Modern art museum in restored 1938 building next to Deoksugung Palace, rotating exhibitions

locations.name: Piknic
locations.description: Immersive art and culture space in Itaewon/Hannam, rotating large-scale exhibitions

locations.name: Seoullo 7017
locations.description: Elevated park on former highway overpass near Seoul Station, 983m walkway with gardens and city views

locations.name: Culture Station Seoul 284
locations.description: Former Seoul Station building (1925), now a cultural space with exhibitions and events, next to Seoullo 7017

locations.name: Bar 81
locations.description: 81st floor of Lotte World Tower (Signiel Seoul), Asia's largest champagne collection, panoramic city views

locations.name: Alice Cheongdam
locations.description: Upscale cocktail bar in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam

locations.name: ZEST SEOUL
locations.description: Asia's #2 bar (50 Best Bars 2025), basement cocktail bar in Apgujeong near Rodeo Station

locations.name: Gebangsikdang
locations.description: Michelin Bib Gourmand ganjang gejang (soy-marinated crab), Gangnam location

locations.name: Bar Cham
locations.description: Asia's #6 bar (50 Best 2025), hanok cocktail bar in Seochon using traditional Korean spirits and ingredients

locations.name: Gallery Hyundai
locations.description: Korea's oldest commercial gallery (1970), contemporary art in Samcheong-dong near Gyeongbokgung

locations.name: Kukje Gallery
locations.description: Leading international gallery in Samcheong-dong, Korean and global contemporary artists, free entry

locations.name: Natural High
locations.description: Natural wine bar near Noksapyeong Station, Haebangchon area

locations.name: Wild Duck & Canteen
locations.description: Natural wine bar with seasonal organic food in Haebangchon, opened by fashion industry friends

locations.name: Leeum Museum of Art
locations.description: Samsung Foundation art museum in Hannam-dong with traditional Korean and contemporary art collections

locations.name: Deepin Oksu
locations.description: Italian/fusion pasta restaurant by Chef Yoon Nam-no in Oksu-dong

locations.name: Big Lights
locations.description: Natural wine bar in Hannam-dong

locations.name: Mirror
locations.description: Wine bar in Bangbae-dong, Seocho District

locations.name: tas
locations.description: Wine bar in Seogyo-dong, Mapo District

locations.name: 곱창전골
locations.description: Gopchang jeongol (tripe hot pot) pub near Hongdae, Mapo District

locations.name: MOWa
locations.description: Restaurant in Myeongdong, Jung District

locations.name: 파브 (Fav)
locations.description: Wine bar near Sookmyung Women's University, Yongsan District

locations.name: TYMM
locations.description: Bar in Yongsan District

locations.name: Pompette Selection
locations.description: Bar in Geumho-dong, Seongdong District

locations.name: BLUE NUDE
locations.description: Wine bar in Hannam-dong, Yongsan District

locations.name: thisisneverthat
locations.description: Graphic tees with unexpected collabs (Grateful Dead, Pokémon, Wasted Youth). Streetwear, not tourist-y. 8 Hongik-ro 3-gil, Hongdae — Mon–Thu 12–23h, Fri–Sun 11–23h

locations.name: TeenyTiger ⭐
locations.description: Traditional Korean cultural references with lightness — Hahoetal masks, gat hats, cranes, Hangul typography. Some dry humor. 64 Sagan-dong, Jongno-gu

locations.name: Human Made
locations.description: Japanese brand (NIGO) — vintage duck, heart, tiger graphics, cute without cheesy. Seoul-exclusive Jindo dog tee. Pricey but quality. 39 Seongsui-ro 7-gil, Seongsu — 11:00–20:00

locations.name: SOUND SHOP Balansa ⭐
locations.description: Busan's OG select shop since 2008. Original screen-printed tees, hoodies, caps + vintage records. Artists and stylists shop here — anti-tourist. 2F, 37 Jeonpo-daero 255beon-gil, Seomyeon — 12:00–19:00

locations.name: Magpie Brewing Co.
locations.description: One of Seoul's founding craft breweries (2012), Gyeongnidan. ~10 house beers on tap. Magpie Pale Ale, seasonal IPAs and sours. Also has Euljiro 4F location.

locations.name: Seoul Brewery
locations.description: #1 rated Korean brewery on Untappd. Hapjeong taproom — sleek, brewing equipment on display. Salinger Rye IPA, Choco Loco Porter, Night Bloom Gose. Also has Seongsu branch.

locations.name: Euljiro Brewing
locations.description: Icon of Seoul's retro-industrial 'Hipjiro' scene. Two taprooms across from each other — main (15:30+) and annex (19:30+). 6 house beers: Pink Chambray Saison, Glen Check Amber Lager, Selvage Porter.

locations.name: The Booth Brewing
locations.description: Gyeongnidan craft brewpub. Known for Kukmin IPA and Mikkeller collab (Taedonggang Pale Ale). Punchy hop-forward styles.

locations.name: Craft Root (Sokcho Beer)
locations.description: Sokcho Beer's Seoul taproom in historic Ikseon-dong hanok alley. ~10 taps themed around Sokcho's coast: Sokcho IPA, Daepo Port Stout, Abai Weizen, Gaetbae Pilsner.

locations.name: Wildcat Brewing
locations.description: Seomyeon brewpub — guests look directly into the brewing vats. Inventive Korean twists: Tiger Paw hoddeok sour, yuzu lager. Tasting trays available.

locations.name: Naked Ape
locations.description: Gorilla Brewing's concept bar inside Millac The Market, Gwangalli seafront. Bay windows with ocean/port views. Exclusive beers: Millac Pilsner, Millac IPA, Millac DIPA.

locations.name: Galmegi Brewing Haeundae
locations.description: Busan's original craft brewpub (2014), Haeundae branch. 2F ocean views, open until 3am Fri/Sat. Galmegi IPA, Busan As F*** DIPA, Moonrise Pale Ale, Yuma Gose, Espresso Vanilla Stout.

locations.name: Gorilla Brewing Haeundae
locations.description: British-founded brewery steps from Haeundae Beach. 20 rotating house taps: Tiramisu Stout, Hop Bomb DIPA, White IPA, Popsicle IPA, seasonal sours.

locations.name: Incheon Brewery
locations.description: Incheon's only city brewpub, Sinpo-dong (Gaehangro heritage district). Gaehangro Lager — Korea's first vegan-certified craft beer. Also: Sabjak IPA, Mongyubyeong DIPA, fruit ales.

locations.name: Playground Brewery Songdo
locations.description: Asia Beer Championship gold medals (lager + NE IPA). Gastropub format with Le Cordon Bleu-trained chef. Gentleman Lager, Hunchback Hazy IPA, Monk IPA. Mon–Fri 15:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 12:00–.
